```{=html}
<div class="sampling-app">
  <div class="app-topbar">
    <div class="app-title">Distribución de los promedios muestrales</div>
  </div>

  <div class="app-body">
    <section class="app-main">
      <div class="tab-strip">
        <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="grandes-numeros">Grandes numeros</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="muestreos-aleatorios">Muestreos aleatorios</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="analisis-dispersion-1">Analisis de dispersión</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="analisis-dispersion-2">Analisis de dispersión</button>
      </div>

      <section class="tab-panel active" data-tab-panel="grandes-numeros">
        <div class="instructions">
          <h2>Instrucciones</h2>
          <p>
            Haga click en los botones de la sección “tamaño muestral” N para observar cómo
            varían los promedios de un número determinado de muestras de una distribución
            normal con promedio fijo.
          </p>
          <p>
            Puede cambiar el número de muestras por tamaño N mediante el control M. Cada
            círculo gris representa el promedio de una muestra y el círculo negro corresponde
            al promedio de todos los promedios muestrales de esa fila.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="workspace">
          <div class="size-panel">
            <h3>Tamaño muestral</h3>
            <div class="size-buttons">
              <div class="size-buttons-shifted">
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="3">N = 3</button>
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="10">N = 10</button>
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="30">N = 30</button>
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="100">N = 100</button>
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="1000">N = 1000</button>
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="10000">N = 10000</button>
              </div>
              <div class="size-buttons-final">
                <button class="size-btn" data-sample-size="100000">N = 100000</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="size-footnote">
              “N” indica la cantidad de individuos que entran en una muestra.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="viz-panel">
            <div class="viz-header">
              <div class="toolbar-main">
                <label class="parameter-toggle" for="population-mean-toggle">
                  <input id="population-mean-toggle" type="checkbox" checked />
                  <span class="toggle-check" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                  <span class="toggle-copy">
                    Parámetro poblacional
                    <small>(promedio)</small>
                  </span>
                </label>

                <div class="m-control">
                  <div class="m-stepper">
                    <div class="m-stepper-buttons">
                      <button class="step-btn" type="button" data-step="1">▲</button>
                      <button class="step-btn" type="button" data-step="-1">▼</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="m-stepper-value">
                      <input id="m-input" type="text" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*" value="30" aria-label="Número de muestras" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span>Número de muestras</span>
                </div>

                <div class="toolbar-actions">
                  <button class="download-btn" id="download-csv" type="button">Descargar CSV</button>
                  <button class="download-btn" id="download-excel" type="button">Descargar Excel</button>
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="reset-chart" type="button">Limpiar gráfico</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="chart-card">
              <svg id="means-chart" viewBox="0 0 760 472" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-label="Distribución de promedios muestrales"></svg>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="legend-row">
          <div class="legend-item">
            <span class="legend-dot"></span>
            <span>Representa el promedio de una muestra.</span>
          </div>
          <div class="legend-item">
            <span class="legend-dot black"></span>
            <span>Representa el gran promedio, es decir, el promedio de todos los promedios muestrales.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="tab-panel" data-tab-panel="muestreos-aleatorios">
        <div class="placeholder-panel">
          <div class="placeholder-card">

            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

      <section class="tab-panel" data-tab-panel="analisis-dispersion-2">
        <div class="placeholder-panel">
          <div class="placeholder-card">
            <h3>Análisis de dispersión 2</h3>
            <p>
              Esta pestaña mantiene la misma estructura visual y está lista para recibir el siguiente
              módulo interactivo.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </section>

</div>

<script>
  const SAMPLE_SIZES = [3, 10, 30, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000];
  const DOMAIN_MIN = 39;
  const DOMAIN_MAX = 46;
  const POPULATION_MEAN = 42.9;
  const POPULATION_SD = 2.25;
  const CASES_STORAGE_KEY = "tlc-simulacion-casos-v1";
  const SHOW_MEAN_STORAGE_KEY = "tlc-simulacion-mostrar-promedio-v1";

  const state = {
    activeTab: "grandes-numeros",
    selectedN: null,
    m: 30,
    rowResults: new Map(),
    cases: [],
    showPopulationMean: true
  };

  function randn() {
    let u = 0;
    let v = 0;
    while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
    while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  function average(values) {
    if (!values.length) return 0;
    return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length;
  }

  function clamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
  }

  function normalizeM(rawValue) {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(rawValue, 10);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 1) {
      return 30;
    }
    return parsed;
  }

  function stableJitter(index, sampleSize) {
    const seed = Math.sin((index + 1) * 12.9898 + sampleSize * 0.031) * 43758.5453;
    return (seed - Math.floor(seed)) - 0.5;
  }

  function simulateSampleMean(sampleSize) {
    const sd = POPULATION_SD / Math.sqrt(sampleSize);
    const value = POPULATION_MEAN + randn() * sd;
    return clamp(value, DOMAIN_MIN - 0.35, DOMAIN_MAX + 0.35);
  }

  function makeCase(sampleSize, m) {
    const means = Array.from({ length: m }, () => Number(simulateSampleMean(sampleSize).toFixed(4)));
    const grandMean = Number(average(means).toFixed(4));
    const maxCaseNumber = state.cases.reduce((max, caseItem) => Math.max(max, caseItem.caseNumber || 0), 0);

    return {
      id: (window.crypto && window.crypto.randomUUID)
        ? window.crypto.randomUUID()
        : `case-${Date.now()}-${sampleSize}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
      caseNumber: maxCaseNumber + 1,
      sampleSize,
      numSamples: m,
      means,
      grandMean,
      populationMean: POPULATION_MEAN,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      populationLineVisible: state.showPopulationMean
    };
  }

  function ensurePreviewRows() {
    if (state.rowResults.size) return;

    SAMPLE_SIZES.forEach((sampleSize) => {
      const previewCase = {
        id: `preview-${sampleSize}`,
        sampleSize,
        numSamples: state.m,
        means: Array.from({ length: state.m }, () => Number(simulateSampleMean(sampleSize).toFixed(4))),
        grandMean: 0,
        populationMean: POPULATION_MEAN,
        createdAt: null,
        populationLineVisible: state.showPopulationMean,
        preview: true
      };

      previewCase.grandMean = Number(average(previewCase.means).toFixed(4));
      state.rowResults.set(sampleSize, previewCase);
    });
  }

  function saveCases() {
    localStorage.setItem(CASES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state.cases));
  }

  function loadState() {
    try {
      const storedCases = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CASES_STORAGE_KEY) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(storedCases)) {
        state.cases = storedCases;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      state.cases = [];
    }

    const storedShowMean = localStorage.getItem(SHOW_MEAN_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (storedShowMean !== null) {
      state.showPopulationMean = storedShowMean === "true";
    }

    let nextNumber = 1;
    let casesChanged = false;
    [...state.cases].reverse().forEach((caseItem) => {
      if (!caseItem.caseNumber) {
        caseItem.caseNumber = nextNumber;
        casesChanged = true;
      }
      nextNumber = Math.max(nextNumber, (caseItem.caseNumber || 0) + 1);
      if (typeof caseItem.populationLineVisible !== "boolean") {
        caseItem.populationLineVisible = true;
        casesChanged = true;
      }
    });
    if (casesChanged) {
      saveCases();
    }

    for (const caseItem of state.cases) {
      if (!state.rowResults.has(caseItem.sampleSize)) {
        state.rowResults.set(caseItem.sampleSize, caseItem);
      }
    }
  }

  function renderButtons() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".size-btn").forEach((button) => {
      const buttonN = Number.parseInt(button.dataset.sampleSize, 10);
      button.classList.toggle("is-selected", state.selectedN === buttonN);
    });
  }

  function renderMeanToggle() {
    const toggle = document.getElementById("population-mean-toggle");
    toggle.checked = state.showPopulationMean;
  }

  function getRowCenters(plotHeight, plotTop) {
    const buttonArea = document.querySelector(".size-buttons");
    const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".size-btn"));

    if (!buttonArea || buttons.length !== SAMPLE_SIZES.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const areaRect = buttonArea.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!areaRect.height) {
      return null;
    }

    const centers = buttons.map((button) => {
      const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
      return rect.top + rect.height / 2 - areaRect.top;
    });

    const firstCenter = centers[0];
    const lastCenter = centers[centers.length - 1];
    const innerTop = plotTop + 10;
    const innerHeight = Math.max(1, plotHeight - 20);

    return centers.map((center) => {
      const t = lastCenter === firstCenter ? 0.5 : clamp((center - firstCenter) / (lastCenter - firstCenter), 0, 1);
      return innerTop + t * innerHeight;
    });
  }

  function renderChart() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("means-chart");
    const width = 760;
    const height = 472;
    const margin = { top: 22, right: 18, bottom: 42, left: 18 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const fallbackRowGap = plotHeight / SAMPLE_SIZES.length;
    const rowCenters = getRowCenters(plotHeight, margin.top) || SAMPLE_SIZES.map((_, rowIndex) => margin.top + fallbackRowGap * (rowIndex + 0.5));
    const rowGap = rowCenters.length > 1
      ? average(rowCenters.slice(1).map((y, index) => y - rowCenters[index]))
      : fallbackRowGap;
    const xScale = (value) => {
      const t = (value - DOMAIN_MIN) / (DOMAIN_MAX - DOMAIN_MIN);
      return margin.left + clamp(t, 0, 1) * plotWidth;
    };

    const pieces = [
      `<rect class="chart-frame" x="${margin.left}" y="${margin.top}" width="${plotWidth}" height="${plotHeight}"></rect>`
    ];

    if (state.showPopulationMean) {
      const meanX = xScale(POPULATION_MEAN);
      pieces.push(
        `<line class="population-line" x1="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" y1="${(margin.top + 2).toFixed(2)}" x2="${meanX.toFixed(2)}" y2="${(height - margin.bottom).toFixed(2)}"></line>`
      );
    }

    SAMPLE_SIZES.forEach((sampleSize, rowIndex) => {
      const y = rowCenters[rowIndex];
      pieces.push(
        `<line class="row-guide" x1="${margin.left}" y1="${y.toFixed(2)}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y2="${y.toFixed(2)}"></line>`
      );

      const rowData = state.rowResults.get(sampleSize);
      if (!rowData) return;

      rowData.means.forEach((meanValue, meanIndex) => {
        const jitter = stableJitter(meanIndex, sampleSize) * Math.min(18, rowGap * 0.28);
        pieces.push(
          `<circle class="sample-dot" cx="${xScale(meanValue).toFixed(2)}" cy="${(y + jitter).toFixed(2)}" r="7.2"></circle>`
        );
      });

      pieces.push(
        `<circle class="grand-dot" cx="${xScale(rowData.grandMean).toFixed(2)}" cy="${y.toFixed(2)}" r="10.6"></circle>`
      );
    });

    pieces.push(
      `<line class="axis-line" x1="${margin.left}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}"></line>`
    );

    for (let tick = DOMAIN_MIN; tick <= DOMAIN_MAX; tick += 1) {
      const x = xScale(tick);
      pieces.push(`<line class="axis-tick" x1="${x}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" x2="${x}" y2="${height - margin.bottom + 7}"></line>`);
      pieces.push(`<text class="axis-label" x="${x}" y="${height - 12}" text-anchor="middle">${tick}</text>`);
    }

    if (!state.rowResults.size) {
      pieces.push(
        `<text class="empty-chart-note" x="${width / 2}" y="${height / 2 - 10}" text-anchor="middle">Seleccione un tamaño muestral para comenzar</text>`
      );
    }

    svg.innerHTML = pieces.join("");
  }

  function setActiveTab(tabId) {
    state.activeTab = tabId;

    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.tab === tabId);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab-panel]").forEach((panel) => {
      panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.tabPanel === tabId);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-sidebar-panel]").forEach((panel) => {
      panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.sidebarPanel === tabId);
    });
  }

  function runSample(sampleSize) {
    const input = document.getElementById("m-input");
    state.m = normalizeM(input.value);
    input.value = state.m;

    const caseItem = makeCase(sampleSize, state.m);
    state.selectedN = sampleSize;
    state.rowResults.set(sampleSize, caseItem);
    state.cases.unshift(caseItem);
    saveCases();
    renderButtons();
    renderChart();
  }

  function resetChart() {
    const input = document.getElementById("m-input");
    state.m = normalizeM(input.value);
    input.value = state.m;
    state.selectedN = null;
    state.rowResults = new Map();
    state.cases = [];
    saveCases();
    renderButtons();
    renderChart();
  }

  function buildExportRows() {
    const orderedCases = [...state.cases].sort((a, b) => (a.caseNumber || 0) - (b.caseNumber || 0));
    const rows = [];

    orderedCases.forEach((caseItem) => {
      caseItem.means.forEach((meanValue, meanIndex) => {
        rows.push({
          case_number: caseItem.caseNumber || "",
          case_id: caseItem.id || "",
          created_at: caseItem.createdAt || "",
          sample_size_n: caseItem.sampleSize,
          num_samples_m: caseItem.numSamples,
          mean_index: meanIndex + 1,
          sample_mean: meanValue,
          grand_mean: caseItem.grandMean,
          population_mean: caseItem.populationMean,
          population_line_visible: caseItem.populationLineVisible ? "true" : "false"
        });
      });
    });

    return rows;
  }

  function escapeCsv(value) {
    const stringValue = String(value ?? "");
    if (/[",\n]/.test(stringValue)) {
      return `"${stringValue.replace(/"/g, "\"\"")}"`;
    }
    return stringValue;
  }

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? "")
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function triggerDownload(filename, content, mimeType) {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function downloadCsv() {
    const rows = buildExportRows();
    const headers = [
      "case_number",
      "case_id",
      "created_at",
      "sample_size_n",
      "num_samples_m",
      "mean_index",
      "sample_mean",
      "grand_mean",
      "population_mean",
      "population_line_visible"
    ];

    const csvLines = [
      headers.join(","),
      ...rows.map((row) => headers.map((header) => escapeCsv(row[header])).join(","))
    ];

    triggerDownload(
      "simulacion-muestreos-datos.csv",
      `\ufeff${csvLines.join("\n")}`,
      "text/csv;charset=utf-8;"
    );
  }

  function downloadExcel() {
    const rows = buildExportRows();
    const headers = [
      "case_number",
      "case_id",
      "created_at",
      "sample_size_n",
      "num_samples_m",
      "mean_index",
      "sample_mean",
      "grand_mean",
      "population_mean",
      "population_line_visible"
    ];

    const tableHead = headers.map((header) => `<th>${escapeHtml(header)}</th>`).join("");
    const tableBody = rows.map((row) => {
      const cells = headers.map((header) => `<td>${escapeHtml(row[header])}</td>`).join("");
      return `<tr>${cells}</tr>`;
    }).join("");

    const workbookHtml = [
      "<html>",
      "<head>",
      '<meta charset="utf-8" />',
      "<style>",
      "table { border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }",
      "th, td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 12px; }",
      "th { background: #d9eefb; }",
      "</style>",
      "</head>",
      "<body>",
      "<" + "table>",
      "<" + "thead><tr>" + tableHead + "</tr></thead>",
      "<" + "tbody>" + tableBody + "</tbody>",
      "</table>",
      "</body>",
      "</html>"
    ].join("");

    triggerDownload(
      "simulacion-muestreos-datos.xls",
      `\ufeff${workbookHtml}`,
      "application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8;"
    );
  }

  function setShowPopulationMean(nextValue) {
    state.showPopulationMean = nextValue;
    localStorage.setItem(SHOW_MEAN_STORAGE_KEY, String(nextValue));
    renderMeanToggle();
    renderChart();
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    loadState();
    ensurePreviewRows();

    document.getElementById("m-input").value = state.m;

    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => setActiveTab(button.dataset.tab));
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".size-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => runSample(Number.parseInt(button.dataset.sampleSize, 10)));
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".step-btn").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const input = document.getElementById("m-input");
        const nextValue = normalizeM(input.value) + Number.parseInt(button.dataset.step, 10);
        input.value = Math.max(1, nextValue);
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("m-input").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      event.target.value = normalizeM(event.target.value);
    });

    document.getElementById("download-csv").addEventListener("click", downloadCsv);
    document.getElementById("download-excel").addEventListener("click", downloadExcel);
    document.getElementById("reset-chart").addEventListener("click", resetChart);
    document.getElementById("population-mean-toggle").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      setShowPopulationMean(event.target.checked);
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => renderChart());
    });

    setActiveTab(state.activeTab);
    renderButtons();
    renderMeanToggle();
    renderChart();
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => renderChart());
  });
</script>
```
